passive.name: Power Chord
passive.text: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

spells.name: Hymn of Valor
spells.text: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

spells.name: Aria of Perseverance
spells.text: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

spells.name: Song of Celerity
spells.text: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.text: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

damage.value: Sona deals burst magic damage with Hymn of Valor, Crescendo, and Power Chord.

archetype.value: Sona is a support who heals and buffs while relying on careful positioning.

axis.value: Sona plays safely in lane and pokes with Q after enemy cooldowns are used.

winCondition.value: Sona sustains through laning phase and wins teamfights with her ultimate and buffs.

spikes.at: Sona gets stronger after her first one or two items
spikes.why: Sona’s skills are not especially strong before then.
Sona becomes stronger through scaling and frequent ability use in fights.
Sona gains a damaging stun against enemy champions.

mistakes.value: Sona players risk getting picked early when they neglect positioning.
Sona players can miss a free Power Chord charge by not using an ability in the fountain.
Sona players make a mistake when they use Q Power Chord after level 1.
